scenario.name: r-cw-2-immediate-wake
scenario.description: Typed continue_work(delaySeconds=0) immediate wake proof. Requires an explicit scheduled sentinel and a continuation wake sentinel, while ignoring harness prompt echoes.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the sessions.send turn that asks the agent to call continue_work(delaySeconds=0).

expectedReceipts.name: continue-work-tool-result-scheduled
expectedReceipts.description: Agent emitted CW2-SCHEDULED only after the continue_work tool result reported scheduled.

expectedReceipts.name: immediate-wake-event
expectedReceipts.description: Continuation wake turn emitted CW2-WOKE nonce sentinel.

expectedReceipts.name: prompt-echo-filtered
expectedReceipts.description: Harness prompt echo was ignored; CW2-WOKE is only accepted after CW2-SCHEDULED.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from dispatch response or optional task metadata for Tempo fetch.

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_work tool → continuation.work → continuation.work.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash and length, holding one continuation.work span, its continuation.work.fire span(s), and the originating continue_work tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: PASS-candidate requires dispatch accepted, explicit scheduled sentinel, explicit immediate wake sentinel, and prompt-echo filtering. Prefer disposable sessions. Expected PARTIAL cause (harness review N7, openclaw-bootstrap#1727): when the wake matures while another run is active in the session, the product folds it into that run as a [system:continuation-note] (src/auto-reply/continuation/work-dispatch.ts:614-640, work-dispatch-execution.ts:234-235) and writes no [continuation:wake] row; the transcript chain then fails closed with chain_reason naming the missing wake. Run in an idle or disposable session.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_work tool span to continuation.work and continuation.work.fire only by shared trace and reason fingerprint. The scenario records the fingerprint of the reason it dispatched, which the manifest reason reproduces from the nonce, so the collector attributes the trace in run and from public evidence afterwards.

spans.name: continuation.work
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_work evidence. Joined to the accepted entry only by shared trace.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The continuation reason is published only as a digest and a length, inside a public-safe Tempo projection. The raw reason, sentinel instructions, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The dispatch is accepted, CW2-SCHEDULED follows the continue_work tool result that reports scheduled, CW2-WOKE arrives on the immediate wake, and one trace joins the tool span to the continuation.work accept and fire spans by reason fingerprint.
controls.negative: A harness prompt echo must not satisfy either sentinel, CW2-WOKE before CW2-SCHEDULED does not count, and more than one trace matching the reason fingerprint is refused as ambiguous.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: Dispatch accepted, the scheduled sentinel after the scheduled tool result, the immediate wake sentinel, and prompt-echo filtering. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Any required sentinel is missing, including a disposable-session run that stops at scheduled-only. A missing or degraded trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Not emitted by this scenario: an incomplete run is PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cw-2-immediate-wake.js fires continue_work(delaySeconds=0) and records the scheduled and wake sentinels.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review confirms the work/fire topology; it cannot supply the missing identity attributes.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continue_work delaySeconds=0 row. Serialize per target session. Disposable-session smoke may honestly stop at scheduled-only on runtimes where disposable sessions do not service self-elected continuation wakes; canonical PASS requires a CW2-WOKE receipt from the target session history or live websocket stream.
